name: @definitive-fi/flash-mcp

tools.name: flash_setup
tools.description: Connect a Definitive account for trading on Flash. The primary setup path is the interactive wizard the user runs in their OWN terminal — `npx -y @definitive-fi/flash-mcp setup` — which handles the API key, funder wallets, and RPCs; direct the user there rather than collecting credentials in chat. Call this tool with no arguments to see what's configured and get the exact instructions to relay. It also accepts `apiKey` (safe in chat — it cannot move funds) and `rpc` overrides. Wallet private keys are NEVER accepted here and must never be pasted into the conversation.

apiKey.description: Definitive Flash API key (starts with dpka_)

organization.description: Your Definitive organization slug (optional). Stored for reference; the setup page uses whichever organization you're logged into, so this is no longer needed to get an API key.

rpc.description: Optional custom RPC URLs per chain, e.g. { "base": "https://…" }. Recommended — the public defaults are rate-limited. Pass an empty string to clear a chain's override.

tools.name: flash_status
tools.description: Show which credentials and wallets are configured, and the supported chains.

tools.name: flash_quote
tools.description: Price a trade across 200+ liquidity sources without executing. Returns the spend/receive amounts and estimated fees. Does not require a wallet.

contraChain.description: Chain of the contra asset (usually same as targetChain)

targetAsset.description: Address of the target (traded) asset. A native gas asset (its symbol like "ETH", "native", the zero address, or the 0xEeee… sentinel) is auto-routed through the chain's wrapped-native token.

contraAsset.description: Address of the contra asset — spent on buys, received on sells. Native gas assets are auto-wrapped like targetAsset (the spent side is wrapped before the trade).

qty.description: Decimal amount being spent: contraAsset units for buys, targetAsset units for sells

maxSlippage.description: Slippage tolerance as a decimal, e.g. 0.01 = 1% (default 0.05)

maxPriceImpact.description: Max price impact as a decimal (default 0.05)

limitNotionalPrice.description: USD limit price; required for limit orders

svmUseNativeSOL.description: Solana: treat spent wSOL as native SOL and wrap it

expireTime.description: ISO-8601 expiry for limit/trigger orders (omit for GTC)

twapBucketCount.description: TWAP only: number of equal-time buckets

notionalPrice.description: USD trigger price on the target asset

tools.name: flash_balances
tools.description: Fetch native and token balances for a wallet, using the built-in per-chain public RPCs (or configured overrides) — no external RPC lookup needed. Defaults to the configured funder wallet. Read-only; works without an API key. Omitting `tokens` lists every token the wallet holds: SPL tokens on Solana, and ERC-20s on EVM chains that have a block explorer configured (auto-discovered, then read live on-chain). Pass explicit `tokens` to query specific addresses, or on EVM chains without explorer support (only the native balance is returned otherwise).

address.description: Wallet address (defaults to the configured funder wallet for this chain)

tokens.description: Token addresses (EVM) or mints (Solana) to include

rpcUrl.description: Override the RPC endpoint for this call

tools.name: flash_submit_order
tools.description: Execute a trade end to end: fetch a fresh quote, send any required wrap/approve transactions, sign the order with your funder wallet, and submit it. For market orders it polls until the order fills (or times out). Requires an API key and the matching funder wallet private key. This spends real funds.

contraChain.description: Chain of the contra asset (usually same as targetChain)

targetAsset.description: Address of the target (traded) asset. A native gas asset (its symbol like "ETH", "native", the zero address, or the 0xEeee… sentinel) is auto-routed through the chain's wrapped-native token.

contraAsset.description: Address of the contra asset — spent on buys, received on sells. Native gas assets are auto-wrapped like targetAsset (the spent side is wrapped before the trade).

qty.description: Decimal amount being spent: contraAsset units for buys, targetAsset units for sells

maxSlippage.description: Slippage tolerance as a decimal, e.g. 0.01 = 1% (default 0.05)

maxPriceImpact.description: Max price impact as a decimal (default 0.05)

limitNotionalPrice.description: USD limit price; required for limit orders

svmUseNativeSOL.description: Solana: treat spent wSOL as native SOL and wrap it

expireTime.description: ISO-8601 expiry for limit/trigger orders (omit for GTC)

twapBucketCount.description: TWAP only: number of equal-time buckets

notionalPrice.description: USD trigger price on the target asset

rpcUrl.description: Override the RPC used for on-chain wrap/approve sends

waitForFill.description: Market orders only: poll until filled (default true)

pollTimeoutSec.description: Max seconds to poll for a fill (default 120)

tools.name: flash_get_order
tools.description: Fetch the status, fills, and details of a single order by id.

orderId.description: The order id returned at submit time

tools.name: flash_list_orders
tools.description: List recent orders for a funder wallet. Defaults to the configured EVM wallet if no address is given.

funderAddress.description: Funder wallet address (defaults to configured EVM wallet)

statuses.description: Filter by status, e.g. ORDER_STATUS_FILLED, ORDER_STATUS_PENDING

pageSize.description: Number of orders to return (max 200, default 50)

tools.name: flash_cancel_order
tools.description: Cancel a resting order (limit/twap/trigger). Signs the cancel message with your funder wallet. Requires the funder private key for the order's chain.

chain.description: The chain the order is on (selects which wallet signs)
